headline: Day before GTA 6 release, PlayStation issues update on mandatory PS5 software installation
caption:
GTA 6 release PS5 update: launch se pehle ye karna zaroori hai 🎮
GTA 6 kal, 19 November ko aa raha hai, GTA V ke 13 saal baad.
Sony ne PS5 par mandatory system software update jaari kiya hai, game khelne se pehle install karna padega.
Game lagbhag 212 GB ka bataya ja raha hai, storage pehle se check kar lo.
Is khabar par ek emoji likho: dil, gussa ya hasi? 👇
